proof:
Source: steps 2–3 of the selected node's supplied proof (countable subcover by Lindelöf, Mathlib TopologicalSpace.isOpen_iUnion_countable, and disjoint pieces A_i := W_i ∖ ⋃_{j<i} W_j, Mathlib disjointed), stated for an arbitrary property p of the covering sets instead of the IMRep data. The case U = ∅ of the supplied step 1 is absorbed by allowing an empty countable index type. Notation: ℝ^P = Euclid P, with its Euclidean topology (second countable) and Borel σ-algebra.

1. (Choice of neighbourhoods.) By hypothesis, every x ∈ U has an open V_x ⊆ ℝ^P with x ∈ V_x, V_x ⊆ U and p(V_x). Choose one such V_x for every x ∈ U (Lean: `choose!`, giving V : ℝ^P → Set ℝ^P with these four properties for every x ∈ U).

2. (The chosen sets cover U.) Index the chosen sets by the points of U (the subtype ↥U): s(x) := V_x. Every s(x) is open, and ⋃_{x∈U} V_x = U. The inclusion ⊆ holds because each V_x ⊆ U. The inclusion ⊇ holds because each y ∈ U lies in V_y.

3. (Lindelöf.) ℝ^P is second countable. So for the family (s(x))_{x∈↥U} of open sets there is a countable set of indices T ⊆ ↥U with ⋃_{x∈T} s(x) = ⋃_{x∈↥U} s(x) (Mathlib TopologicalSpace.isOpen_iUnion_countable). By step 2 both unions equal U.

4. (Case T = ∅.) Then U = ⋃_{x∈∅} s(x) = ∅. Take ι := Empty, a countable type with no elements, and let W and A be the empty families (Empty.elim). Every condition quantified over i holds vacuously, and so does pairwise disjointness. Finally ⋃_i A_i = ∅ = U. This proves the claim when T = ∅.

5. (Case T ≠ ∅: enumeration.) T is countable and nonempty. So T = range f for some f : ℕ → ↥U (Set.Countable.exists_eq_range). Put ι := ℕ, which is countable, and W_n := s(f(n)) = V_{f(n)}. Since f(n) ∈ U, step 1 shows that W_n is open, W_n ⊆ U and p(W_n) holds.

6. (Disjoint Borel pieces.) Put A := disjointed W, i.e. A_n = W_n ∖ ⋃_{j<n} W_j. Then:
(a) Each A_n is Borel, because it is built from the open, hence Borel, sets W_j by finitely many differences (MeasurableSet.disjointed).
(b) A_n ⊆ W_n (disjointed_subset).
(c) The sets A_n are pairwise disjoint (disjoint_disjointed).
(d) ⋃_n A_n = ⋃_n W_n (iUnion_disjointed).

7. (The pieces cover U.) ⋃_n W_n = ⋃_n s(f(n)) = ⋃_{x ∈ range f} s(x) (biUnion_range) = ⋃_{x∈T} s(x) = U by step 3. With step 6(d), ⋃_n A_n = U.

8. (Conclusion.) In the case T ≠ ∅, steps 5–7 give all seven required properties with ι = ℕ. In the case T = ∅, step 4 gives them. ∎

It was placed after `import GMT.Ch07.Submission` in the child comparator scope, i.e. inside `namespace GMT.Ch07` with the frozen contract's `open` commands (`open Filter Function Set MeasureTheory Metric`, `open scoped ENNReal Topology`, `open Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter06`, `open Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03 (CountablyRectifiable HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt)`), after the contract's `noncomputable section ... end`. `#print axioms` reports only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

```lean
theorem Submission.cbrg_exists_countable_disjoint_refinement : ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (p : Set (Euclid P) → Prop), (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ x ∈ W ∧ W ⊆ U ∧ p W) → ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Countable ι) (W A : ι → Set (Euclid P)), (∀ i, IsOpen (W i)) ∧ (∀ i, W i ⊆ U) ∧ (∀ i, p (W i)) ∧ (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) ∧ (∀ i, A i ⊆ W i) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) ∧ ⋃ i, A i = U := by
  intro P U p h
  choose! V hVo hxV hVU hpV using h
  let s : U → Set (Euclid P) := fun x => V x
  -- Lindelöf: countably many of the open sets `s x` already cover `⋃ x, s x = U`
  obtain ⟨T, hTc, hTU⟩ := TopologicalSpace.isOpen_iUnion_countable s (fun x => hVo x x.2)
  have hsU : ⋃ x, s x = U := by
    apply subset_antisymm
    · exact iUnion_subset fun x => hVU x x.2
    · intro y hy
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hxV y hy⟩
  rcases T.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hT | hT
  · -- `T = ∅` forces `U = ∅`: take the empty index type
    have hU : U = ∅ := by
      rw [← hsU, ← hTU, hT]
      simp
    refine ⟨Empty, inferInstance, Empty.elim, Empty.elim, fun i => i.elim, fun i => i.elim,
      fun i => i.elim, fun i => i.elim, fun i => i.elim, fun i => i.elim, ?_⟩
    rw [hU]
    exact iUnion_of_empty _
  · -- enumerate `T = range f` and disjointify `Wₙ = s (f n)`
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hTc.exists_eq_range hT
    let W : ℕ → Set (Euclid P) := fun n => s (f n)
    refine ⟨ℕ, inferInstance, W, disjointed W, fun n => hVo _ (f n).2, fun n => hVU _ (f n).2,
      fun n => hpV _ (f n).2, MeasurableSet.disjointed (fun n => (hVo _ (f n).2).measurableSet),
      disjointed_subset W, disjoint_disjointed W, ?_⟩
    rw [iUnion_disjointed, ← hsU, ← hTU, hf, biUnion_range]
```
key_steps: Choose an open V_x with x ∈ V_x ⊆ U and p(V_x) for each x ∈ U; these sets cover U.
Lindelöf (TopologicalSpace.isOpen_iUnion_countable): a countable index set T ⊆ U already has ⋃_{x∈T} V_x = U.
If T = ∅ then U = ∅: take ι := Empty with empty families (all conditions vacuous, ⋃ = ∅ = U).
Otherwise T = range f with f : ℕ → U; take ι := ℕ, W_n := V_{f n} (open, ⊆ U, p holds).
A := disjointed W: Borel, A_n ⊆ W_n, pairwise disjoint, and ⋃ A_n = ⋃ W_n = ⋃_{x∈T} V_x = U.
